frase_clave: Behold, my mother and my brothers!
reflexion: Jesus invites you today to be part of his true family by doing the Father's will. Are you ready to listen to God's voice and live as the Lord's true brother?

escenas.descripcion: Inside a humble Galilean home, Jesus speaks with warmth to an attentive crowd, while the Virgin Mary and His relatives stand waiting near the sunlit doorway.
A man from the gathering leans close to Jesus to deliver the message, while Jesus looks back at him with serene and thoughtful attention.
Jesus affectionately extends His open hand toward His gathered disciples, looking upon them with tender love as He identifies them as His family.

titulo: A reading from the holy Gospel according to Matthew.
texto_evangelio: At that time, while he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him. One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.” But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?” He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers! For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”

fragmentos.texto: A reading from the holy Gospel according to Matthew.
At that time, while he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.

“Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”

“Behold, my mother and my brothers! For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”

frase_es: Estos son mi madre y mis hermanos.
reflexion_es: Jesús te invita hoy a formar parte de su verdadera familia cumpliendo la voluntad del Padre. ¿Estás dispuesto a escuchar la voz de Dios y vivir como un verdadero hermano del Señor?
